correctness.rationale: Adjacency of C_n square K_2 has branches c_k±1, c_k=2cos(2pi k/n). Cesaro spectral averaging gives R_n=(4n²)^-1 sum multiplicity². The cross-branch equation a-b=2 for cyclotomic cosine sums forces nonnegative conjugates of the algebraic integer a; the trace mu(m) and integral norm force a in {0,1,2}, and the only collisions require 4|n (a,b)=(2,0),(0,-2) or 6|n (1,-1). Multiplicity-squared increments are +8 each, proving R_n=1/n-(1+[2|n])/(2n²)+2([4|n]+[6|n])/n². Schur product of merged orthogonal spectral projectors proves product-mixing PSD inequality, with strict positive diagonal excess exactly in resonant cases. Independent direct spectral multiplicity enumeration for n=3..84 agrees exactly; it does not establish infinite collision exclusion.
